Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

language — the words people speak in a country. Example: English is a world language.
speak — to say words. Example: I speak two languages.
understand — to know what words mean. Example: I understand a little English.
well — in a good way. Example: She speaks French well.
a little — a small quantity. Example: I speak a little German.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I speak...
• I can speak...
• I understand a little.
• Do you speak English?
• How well do you speak it?

Grammar focus: Modal verb 'can' / 'can't' for ability.
Use can + verb for ability: I can speak English. Negative: I can't speak German. Question: Can you speak French? Short answer: Yes, I can.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Complete: I ___ speak French.
Choose the correct negative.
Complete the sentence.
Reading: read the text and answer the questions.

I can speak Spanish and English. I can't speak German. My sister can speak three languages well. I study English every day and I listen to the radio in the car. My brother can speak Italian and French.
